skills.name: Random Element (风雷两生/風雷)
skills.line: Bow to the might of the wind! No, tremble at the fearsome lightning!
skills.description: Ryoumenbotoke uses one of his faces to strike a single target; dealing damage equal to 100% of their ATK if Raijin strikes; or dealing damage equal to 25% of their ATK and inflicts Wind Fury, deals indirect damage equal to 125% of their ATK and lasts for 1 turn, if Fujin strikes. ;Wind Fury (風の怒り) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Inflicts indirect damage at the end of turn.

Raijin's damage increases to 125% and Fujin's damage increases to 32%, indirect damage also increases to 157%.

skills.name: Eyes of Wrath (怒目/睨み)
skills.line: Hide all you like! There is no escaping our wrath!
skills.description: When Ryoumenbotoke attacks, Rajin has a 100% base chance of inflicting targets with Eyes of Wrath: Thunder and Fujin has a 100% base chance of inflicting targets with Eyes of Wrath: Wind. Both effects lasts for turns. ;Eyes of Wrath：Thunder (雷の怒目) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Decreases DEF by 10%. ;Eyes of Wrath：Wind (風の怒目) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Decreases ATK by 10%.

upgrades.text: '''Eyes of Wrath''': DEF and ATK increase to 12%.

When Raijin attacks, decreases the move bar of all enemies with ATK lower than his own by 8%. When Fujin inflicts indirect damage on enemies with DEF lower than his own, increases his move bar by 8%.

skills.name: Divine Combo (神罪连击/雷鳴)
skills.line: Raging winds and lightning together are my favorite kind of weather.
skills.description: Ryoumenbotoke invades the enemy line-up and uses one of his faces to attack all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 44% of their ATK with each attack if Raijin strikes; or dealing damage equal to 11% of their ATK with each attack and inflicts Vortex Assault, deals indirect damage equal to 55% of their ATK and lasts for 1 turn, if Fujin strikes. ;Vortex Assault (風の襲撃) : :'''Debuff, Status''': Inflicts indirect damage at the end of turn.
